instruction: A glazed porcelain ballerina frozen mid-arabesque atop a small round fluted plinth, one leg extended straight behind and both arms swept overhead. Her tutu is a thin ruffled disc of bone-white ceramic with hand-painted cobalt scrollwork, and the bodice carries a delicate gold luster line. Crackle glaze catches light across the smooth limbs and the sculpted bun of hair.
